title: Vertra base images (bases.yaml), format v2
description: The base images this catalog approves: each copied into its registry (<registry>/bases/<name>), pinned and scanned, for its products' Dockerfiles to build FROM (./vertra catalog bases mirror; --use-mirror points the Dockerfiles at the copies).

image.description: The image to copy, by tag, as a Dockerfile's FROM names it: python:3.12-slim-bookworm, gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot. Each mirror copies what the tag names then.
